description:
# 1.48.0 (2026-10-22)

### Duolingo

* Update Restore learning reminders for Duolingo 6.102.4.
* Enable and reschedule local reminders when FCM device registration fails.
* Publish this supplemental bundle through the BeForU/morphe-patches repository source.

This source contains only Restore learning reminders. Keep your existing source for other patches and use Expert mode to select both sources.
